needs_human.note: When the frontmatter is invalid YAML, or runs past the 4096-byte read so its closing `---` is never seen, frontmatter.parse returns the whole text as the body. extract_cover then reads URLs inside the frontmatter as body links for the site. Step 14 and I7 are silent on this case.; When a shelf page's refresh re-asks several pages, it drops drawn cards those pages no longer name, unless the card is being saved (usePagedClips.ts:103-106). Step 5 says only that later pages already drawn stay.
